cleanup_commands_for_manual_review:
cat > /tmp/sw2_probe.sh <<'EOF'
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash
echo "prefix: $(ros2 pkg prefix scan_watch_v2)"; echo "executables: $(ros2 pkg executables scan_watch_v2)"
LOG=$(mktemp); setsid ros2 launch scan_watch_v2 monitor.launch.py "$@" >"$LOG" 2>&1 & LPID=$!
trap 'kill -INT -$LPID 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; kill -KILL -$LPID 2>/dev/null; echo "--- launch log"; cat $LOG' EXIT
NS=${PROBE_NS:-field_v2}
for i in $(seq 40); do ros2 node list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "/$NS/scan_watch_v2" && break; sleep 0.25; done
echo "--- nodes"; ros2 node list
echo "--- param"; ros2 param get /$NS/scan_watch_v2 limit
echo "--- scan sub QoS"; ros2 topic info -v /$NS/scan | grep -E 'Node name|Endpoint type|Reliability'
# best-effort synthetic publisher; bounded run
timeout 12 ros2 topic pub -r 5 --qos-reliability best_effort --qos-durability volatile /$NS/scan sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan \
 "{range_min: 0.1, range_max: 10.0, ranges: [0.05, 0.3, 0.42, 0.5, 0.7, 0.82, 0.9, .inf, .nan]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 & PPID2=$!
echo "--- near_count (sample scan)"; timeout 10 ros2 topic echo --once /$NS/near_count std_msgs/msg/Int32
kill $PPID2 2>/dev/null; wait $PPID2 2>/dev/null
timeout 12 ros2 topic pub -r 5 --qos-reliability best_effort /$NS/scan sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan "{range_min: 0.1, range_max: 10.0, ranges: []}" >/dev/null 2>&1 & PPID2=$!
echo "--- near_count (empty scan)"; timeout 10 ros2 topic echo --once /$NS/near_count std_msgs/msg/Int32
kill $PPID2 2>/dev/null; wait $PPID2 2>/dev/null
EOF
bash /tmp/sw2_env.sh 'bash /tmp/sw2_probe.sh namespace:=field_v2 limit:=0.82'
note: Keyword precheck is not a complete semantic audit. Inspect commands and ownership before concluding.
